turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's essay. Why did he get a zero?
We just sat down. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
Resolved? Nothing has been said yet. Who decided on the zero?
No. Not until you show me what you have.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You need it. I need to see a document. Is there one?
